description: Approval Request entity, as read by requesters, opening gears, approvers, and administrators (PRD cpt-cf-approval-service-fr-create-request, cpt-cf-approval-service-upreq-request-read). A request is opened only by a verification call with the register option when approval is required and unsatisfied; at most one open request exists per (opportunity, projection, subject). Records are anonymous instances: 'id' is a UUID and the GTS type of the opportunity is carried in 'opportunity_type'. This type is the PDP resource type for the request read, withdraw, and escalate permissions (DESIGN cpt-cf-approval-service-entity-request).

id.description: Request identifier (UUIDv7). Also the subject ID of every request event.

opportunity_type.description: GTS type of the opportunity, derived from gts.cf.core.approval.opportunity.v1~.

requester_id.description: Authenticated identity on whose behalf the opening verification call was made.

requester_tenant_id.description: Tenant of the requester; request events are also published here when it differs from the subject tenant.

opened_by.description: Service identity of the gear that made the opening verification call.

context.description: Context attributes stored with the request, validated against the opportunity's declaration. Returned only to the requester, holders of the approve permission, and administrators of the scope; omitted for other readers, including the opening gear (PRD cpt-cf-approval-service-nfr-data-classification).

context_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 digest (hex) of the canonical JSON (RFC 8785) of the context attributes. Approve decisions recorded against the request are bound to it.

justification.description: Optional justification from the caller. Same visibility as 'context'.

correlation_id.description: Caller correlation ID echoed in verdicts and request events (PRD cpt-cf-approval-service-fr-correlation).

status.description: 'open' or 'closed'. Enum evolution: new values only in a new major; readers treat unknown values as closed.

outcome.description: Verdict outcome that settled the request. Present only when close_reason is 'verdict_settled'.

close_reason.description: Why the request closed. Enum evolution: new values only in a new major; readers treat unknown values as closed without approval.

unmet_requirements.description: For an open request: the requirements of the applicable policies that are not yet satisfied (current stage only for staged policies, p2).

escalation_level.description: Number of escalations of an open request (p2, PRD cpt-cf-approval-service-fr-request-escalation). Zero when never escalated.

verdict_version.description: Monotonic version of the change that last affected this request.
